description: Comment on text in a Google Doc: `quotedText` is the text the comment sits on, found the way edit_doc finds old_string (markup-tolerant; text that matches more than once is refused with the context of each match, so quote more of it). The comment stays on that text as it moves. Docs has no comment on the whole doc, so quotedText is required; put overall feedback on the title, or on its first words. The tab comes from path, and segment: "header" or "footer" comments in the page header or footer. To reply to an existing comment instead, pass replyTo (a comment id from list_comments) and no quotedText; the reply goes to the doc named by path, whatever its tab.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

page.description: which header/footer, when a doc defines more than one (default-page, first-page, even-page). Omit to use whichever exists.

path.description: The doc or tab: a Drive id or URL, /folder/doc, or /folder/doc/tab (nested: /folder/doc/tab/child). A doc with one tab needs no tab step; a doc with several is refused until one is named, and the refusal lists every tab path.

quotedText.description: the text to comment on; required unless replyTo is given

replyTo.description: a comment id (from list_comments) to reply to; omit to start a new comment

segment.description: which content tree to target: body (default), or the page header/footer. Header/footer content is invisible to a body read — a letterhead logo lives there.

name: add_comment
title: Add a comment or reply
